targets.indicator_en: Cumulative reduction in energy consumption per unit of GDP since 2020
targets.indicator_zh: 单位GDP能源消耗降低（五年累计）

source.title: 14th FYP Outline, 专栏1 “十四五”时期经济社会发展主要指标 (gov.cn, 2021-03-13)

targets.note: Modelled as cumulative reduction from a 2020 base of 0. DEFINITION CHANGE: from the 2023 communiqué the official basis excludes feedstock energy and non-fossil consumption (扣除原料用能和非化石能源消费量). Annual communiqué figures −2.7 (2021), −0.1 (2022), −0.5 (2023), −3.8 (2024), −5.1 (2025) are therefore not compounded here. The official five-year outcome on the adjusted basis is −16.1% (NBS 十四五成就报告之十四, 2026-06-05; NDRC gave −11.6% for 2021–2024). No cumulative figure on the original definition has been published.

source.title: 新型数据中心发展三年行动计划（2021—2023年） (gov.cn 政策文件库)

targets.target_text: 国家枢纽节点算力规模占比超过70%
targets.note: Origin of the widely quoted '70%' hub share. No official stock-share figure for all computing has been published; later documents switched to a share of NEW capacity (edwc23_new_compute_share), and the NDA's July-2026 '超80%' is a stock share of 智算 only.

targets.indicator_zh: 算力规模

source.title: 算力基础设施高质量发展行动计划 (cac.gov.cn, 2023-10-10)

targets.note: No official FP32 end-2025 figure exists: 数字中国发展报告（2025年）and MIIT's 2026 briefings report only FP16 智能算力 (1,590 EFLOPS end-2025), which cannot be compared with the 230→280 FP32 series. The target therefore stays unresolved rather than being scored on a mismatched unit.

targets.indicator_en: Intelligent (AI) computing share of total computing power
targets.indicator_zh: 智能算力占比

source.title: 算力基础设施高质量发展行动计划 (cac.gov.cn, 2023-10-10)

targets.note: No official share has been published for any year: MIIT gives 智能算力 in FP16 EFLOPS and 算力总规模 in FP32, and dividing them would be a unit error. The 25.4% (2023) figure in circulation is CAICT's (secondary) and is not used.

targets.indicator_zh: 存储总量

source.title: 算力基础设施高质量发展行动计划 (cac.gov.cn, 2023-10-10)

targets.note: 存力总规模 (capacity): 800 EB (2021), >1,000 EB (2022), ≈1.2 ZB (2023), >1,680 EB (June 2025, MIIT). No official end-2025 total was found — 数字中国发展报告（2025年）gives 数据存储总量 2.53 ZB, a different metric (data stored, not capacity). Mid-2026 figures (2,021 EB) are CAICT's and are not used.

targets.indicator_en: Advanced storage share of total capacity
targets.indicator_zh: 先进存储容量占比

source.title: 算力基础设施高质量发展行动计划 (cac.gov.cn, 2023-10-10)

targets.note: No official 先进存力占比 has been published; the 32% (mid-2026) in circulation is CAICT's. The only official advanced-storage figure is the absolute 540 EB (2025) in the ICT 15th FYP table (see ict15_adv_storage).

targets.indicator_en: Hub-node regions' share of national NEW computing power
targets.indicator_zh: 国家枢纽节点地区各类新增算力占全国新增算力比重

source.title: 关于深入实施“东数西算”工程 加快构建全国一体化算力网的实施意见 (ndrc.gov.cn, 2023-12-29)

targets.note: Measured on NEW capacity each year, not the stock. 数字中国发展报告: 2024 '枢纽节点地区各类新增算力占全国新增算力的60%以上'; 2025 '80%以上' (p.9). Floors recorded as ≥60 and ≥80.

targets.indicator_en: Green-power share in newly built hub-node data centers
targets.indicator_zh: 国家枢纽节点新建数据中心绿电占比

source.title: 关于深入实施“东数西算”工程 加快构建全国一体化算力网的实施意见 (ndrc.gov.cn, 2023-12-29)

targets.note: No national outcome figure published: NEA/NDA restated the 80% target in March 2025; 数字中国发展报告（2024年）says only '甘肃庆阳等绿电使用率超过80%'. Cluster-level press claims (e.g. 和林格尔 >85%) are secondary and not used.

targets.indicator_zh: 全国数据中心整体上架率

source.title: 数据中心绿色低碳发展专项行动计划 (gov.cn PDF, 2024-07-24)

targets.target_text: 整体上架率不低于60% (by end-2025)
targets.note: National 上架率 was 71.4% at end-June 2026 (MIIT, 2026-07-20) — after the 2025 deadline, so the target reads unresolved. No end-2025 national figure located.

targets.indicator_zh: 全国数据中心平均电能利用效率

source.title: 数据中心绿色低碳发展专项行动计划 (gov.cn PDF, 2024-07-24)

targets.target_text: 平均电能利用效率降至1.5以下 (by end-2025)
targets.note: 数字中国发展报告: all 算力中心 average 1.48 (2023), 1.46 (2024); MIIT: 1.42 at end-June 2025. DEFINITION CHANGE: the 2025 report switched to 超大型算力设施 only (1.34 at end-2025), which is not the same population and is not scored here.

targets.indicator_zh: 国家枢纽节点数据中心项目电能利用效率

source.title: 数据中心绿色低碳发展专项行动计划 (gov.cn PDF, 2024-07-24)

targets.note: Applies to new hub-node projects. NDA (2025-03-18): hub clusters average 'PUE 1.3左右' across ALL existing facilities, so it does not score this target; no new-build average has been published.

targets.indicator_en: PUE of new or expanded large and hyperscale data centers
targets.indicator_zh: 新建及改扩建大型和超大型数据中心电能利用效率

source.title: 数据中心绿色低碳发展专项行动计划 (gov.cn PDF, 2024-07-24)

targets.note: 2025 value is the '新建大型超大型算力设施运行电能利用效率（PUE）1.25' printed in the ICT 15th FYP indicator table (2025 column), the closest official statement of the new-build average.

targets.indicator_zh: 智能算力规模

source.title: 信息通信行业发展“十五五”规划, 专栏1 主要指标 (MIIT PDF, p.2)

targets.note: FP16 (数字中国发展报告（2025年）: '智能算力规模达到159万PFLOPS（FP16，下同）'). 2025 baseline 1,590 EFLOPS; MIIT reported 2,185 EFLOPS at end-June 2026.

targets.indicator_zh: 先进存力规模

source.title: 信息通信行业发展“十五五”规划, 专栏1 主要指标 (MIIT PDF, p.2)

targets.note: Plan table: '先进存力规模（EB） 2025年 540 2030年 1700 〔1160〕'. Modelled as a level target from the printed 2025 base. No official share of advanced storage is published.

targets.indicator_zh: 千兆以上宽带用户数

source.title: 信息通信行业发展“十五五”规划, 专栏1 主要指标 (MIIT PDF, p.2)

targets.note: Plan table prints 2.4亿户 (2025) → 3.2亿户 (2030); the 2025 通信业统计公报 gives 2.38亿户 and the NBS communiqué 23,839万户.

targets.indicator_zh: 5G（含5G-A）用户普及率

source.title: 信息通信行业发展“十五五”规划, 专栏1 主要指标 (MIIT PDF, p.2)

targets.note: MIIT's 普及率 is 5G users per 100 population (85.7 at end-2025), not the share of mobile subscribers (65.9% in the 2025 通信业统计公报). Plan table prints 85.7 → 95 〔9.3〕.

targets.indicator_zh: 信息通信行业收入

source.title: 信息通信行业发展“十五五”规划, 专栏1 主要指标 (MIIT PDF, p.2)

targets.note: Broad definition: 基础电信企业及规模以上互联网企业 revenue (footnote ③). The narrower 电信业务收入 (1.75万亿 in 2025) is a component, not this indicator.
